(() => { const f = document.querySelector('.edit-preview-iframe'); const d = f.contentDocument; const z = parseFloat(f.style.zoom) || 1; const put = (id, r) => { const fr = f.getBoundingClientRect(); const m = document.createElement('div'); m.id = id; m.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;left:' + (fr.left + scrollX + r.left * z) + 'px;top:' + (fr.top + scrollY + r.top * z) + 'px;width:' + (r.width * z) + 'px;height:' + (r.height * z) + 'px'; document.body.append(m); }; const t = d.querySelector('[data-edit-section="events"][data-edit-field="title"]'); t.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover', { bubbles: true })); const es = [...d.querySelectorAll('.ec-item-hover')]; let l = 1e9, tp = 1e9, r = 0, b = 0; for (const e of es) { const q = e.getBoundingClientRect(); l = Math.min(l, q.left); tp = Math.min(tp, q.top); r = Math.max(r, q.right); b = Math.max(b, q.bottom); } put('cap-block', { left: l - 30, top: tp - 8, width: r - l + 30, height: b - tp + 16 }); put('cap-grip', d.querySelector('.ec-grip').getBoundingClientRect()); })()
